description: B5 forward: start-up of steady shear and of uniaxial extension, Caputo time-fractional upper-convected Maxwell (Hookean dumbbell) conformation tensor, C(0) = I; dimensionless time tau = t/T in [0,1], Theta = T/lambda, tau_c = lambda

frames.definition: Q = Rz(a) Ry(b) Rx(c), angles in degrees; Ghat' = Q Ghat Q^T, C' = Q C Q^T

variant_definitions.outputs: sym: X = C0 + s g Sym(N) (component-wise s_ij with loss comp); factor: X = T T^T, T = T0 + sqrt(s) g N; anchor: X = C0 + s g N N^T; logm: X = expm(log C0 + log(1+s) g Sym(N))
variant_definitions.losses: fro: |R|_F^2/s^2; comp: sum_ij (R_ij/s_ij)^2; rel: |R|_F^2/|X|_F^2; nat: tr(X^-1 R X^-1 R)

scale.rule: s = max_n |C^n - C0|_F and s_ij = max(max_n |C_ij^n - C0_ij|, 1) of the implicit L1 solution on a 64-step graded mesh

test.definition: 400 uniform midpoints (j-0.5)/400 plus 100 log-spaced points in [1e-6, 1e-2]

variants_extra_note: run separately with --variants sym-rel (scale-free residual for the unconstrained output, added after the pilot study)
